limitations: Historical windows are unlabeled; control flags are not measured false positives and synthetic new flags are not measured field recall.
Each synthetic ramp changes one variable over 24 hours independently; out-of-range cases are skipped, not clipped.
Humidity in these NOAA samples is derived from temperature and dew point; independent changes can be physically inconsistent.
Windows overlap in their baseline history and cannot be treated as independent trials. These station-months have been explored in earlier project experiments.
This evaluation does not change the live detector, stored telemetry, incidents, or notifications.
